shapeSummary: NEMA 17 stepper motor with a 42.3 x 38 x 42.3 mm square body. Its axis runs along +Y with the bottom (rear face) at Y=0. A 22 mm pilot boss sits on the front face, with an 8 mm lead screw rising from it to Y=220. A flanged nut (10 mm barrel, 22 mm flange) sits on the screw at Y=90 to 101.5. Four 3 mm blind holes, 4 mm deep, are on the 31 mm square pattern in the front face.
warnings: The listed 182 mm length is ambiguous. I assumed it is the screw protruding beyond the 38 mm body, giving 220 mm overall. If it is the overall length, the screw is too long.
The screw axis is placed along Y so the bottom of the part is the motor rear face. The image analysis used Z as the axis.
The 31 mm hole spacing, 3 mm hole diameter and 4 mm depth are standard NEMA 17 assumptions, not stated values.
The nut position along the screw, the nut diameters and the 8 mm screw diameter are estimated from the image and the Tr8 spec.
The four nut mounting holes are omitted because their size and pattern are unknown.
The body corner chamfers, rear flange details, cable and wires, labels and threads are not modeled.

def cyl(d, h, y0):
    return cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(origin=(0, y0, 0), xDir=(1, 0, 0), normal=(0, 1, 0))).circle(d / 2).extrude(h)

S = 42.3
L = 38.0
body = cq.Workplane('XY').box(S, L, S, centered=(True, False, True))
boss = cyl(22, 2, L)
screw = cyl(8, 182, L)
nut_barrel = cyl(10, 8, 90)
nut_flange = cyl(22, 3.5, 98)
part = body.union(boss).union(screw).union(nut_barrel).union(nut_flange)
for x in (-15.5, 15.5):
    for z in (-15.5, 15.5):
        h = cq.Workplane(cq.Plane(origin=(x, L - 4, z), xDir=(1, 0, 0), normal=(0, 1, 0))).circle(1.5).extrude(4)
        part = part.cut(h)
